The Export button now works, and the fix is committed as `15ffaba`.

**Cause:** `OrdersPage.__init__` registered a handler only for "refresh". Clicking "export" found no handler and returned without doing anything.

**Fix** (`src/orders-web/orders_page.py`): register `self._on("export", self.export)` in `__init__`, next to the refresh registration.

**Test** (`tests/test_orders_web.py`): added `test_export_button_writes_one_download`, which goes through `click("export")` the way the button does. All 9 tests pass with `python3 -m unittest`. I didn't run the new test against the unfixed code, but without the registration `click` has no handler to call, so it would fail.

**Left uncommitted:** your edit to `README.md` (the "Note to self" line) and the untracked `notes/` directory. They aren't part of this fix.

One thing to decide: your README note asks whether Export should include cancelled orders. The current export writes every order, cancelled ones included. I didn't change that.
